# `fintech_account_currency_matches_country`

> Accounts are opened in the local currency of their country.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__accounts` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__accounts`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `(country, currency) in (('US', 'USD'), ('MX', 'MXN'), ('CO', 'COP'), ('ES', 'EUR'), ('BR', 'BRL'))`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_account_currency_matches_country`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
